stories.title: Spain housing protests target 'vulture funds' in Madrid
stories.summary: Hundreds of protesters pitched tents in central Madrid to blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis, as the prime minister called a snap election. Housing affordability is now a central political issue in the country.

stories.title: Venezuela ex-leader Maduro charged with conspiracy to commit torture
stories.summary: Former Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro was charged with conspiracy to commit torture over the alleged abuse of US citizens held in Venezuela while he was in power. The new accusations deepen his legal jeopardy.

stories.title: Russian strike on buses in Kramatorsk kills at least 30
stories.summary: A Russian glide-bomb attack hit two crowded civilian buses in the frontline city of Kramatorsk, killing at least 30 people, Ukrainian officials said. It comes amid a surge in Russian strikes and rising civilian casualties.

stories.title: Tanker hit by projectiles in Gulf off Qatar
stories.summary: A maritime agency reported that an oil and chemical tanker was struck by multiple projectiles in the Gulf off Qatar, with casualties reported. The area is a key shipping route, so the attack raises fresh regional security concerns.

stories.title: OpenAI revenue reportedly about $20B below earlier projections
stories.summary: A new report says OpenAI's annualized revenue is roughly $20 billion less than the ~$70 billion previously signaled, a gap that could weigh on its huge infrastructure commitments. The AI lab has not confirmed the figure.

stories.title: Google adds agentic AI to Gemini for businesses
stories.summary: Google is turning Gemini into an agent that can plan and execute tasks across business apps, delegate work to subagents, and even get its own workplace identity and email address. The move pushes Gemini from assistant toward autonomous workflow tool.

stories.title: Anthropic updates usage policy to ban abuse and election interference
stories.summary: Anthropic changed its usage policy to explicitly bar extreme abuse of Claude plus election interference, deceptive campaigns and weapons development. Ordinary frustration or criticism of the model remains allowed.

stories.title: USA Today sues OpenAI over copyright
stories.summary: USA Today and several local newspapers it owns sued OpenAI, alleging the company copied hundreds of thousands of articles to train its models. It is the latest major publisher lawsuit against the AI firm.

stories.title: Browns-themed Hulu drama 'The Land' to premiere after Super Bowl
stories.summary: Hulu's Browns-themed series 'The Land', from This Is Us creator Dan Fogelman and starring Christopher Meloni and Mandy Moore, will debut with two episodes on Feb. 15, 2027, after the Super Bowl.

stories.title: Browns keeping all four quarterbacks on 53-man roster
stories.summary: Cleveland plans to retain all four quarterbacks, treating the young passers as developmental assets and possible trade currency rather than roster cuts. The approach reflects the team's emphasis on quarterback depth.

stories.title: Five Browns stars behind Cleveland's surprising 3-1 start
stories.summary: Analysis highlights the players driving Cleveland's 3-1 start, from a record-setting rookie receiver to a kicker who has been reliable. The Browns sit atop the AFC North after a primetime win over Pittsburgh.

stories.title: Denzel Boston emerging as Browns explosive deep threat
stories.summary: Rookie receiver Denzel Boston has become Cleveland's top offensive weapon, leading all first-year receivers with 284 yards and multiple plays of 46-plus yards through four games.

stories.title: Five-star defensive lineman changes Ohio State visit plans
stories.summary: A five-star defensive line target altered his visit plans for this weekend's Maryland game, while a 2029 linebacker set a visit date. Recruiting visits are a key subplot as Ohio State hosts on homecoming weekend.

stories.title: Five things to know about Maryland before Buckeyes matchup
stories.summary: No. 5 Ohio State (4-1, 2-0) hosts a reeling Maryland (2-3, 0-2) that is on a three-game losing streak for homecoming on Saturday. The preview flags Maryland's quarterback situation as a key factor.

stories.title: Ohio State receiver room banged up heading into Maryland game
stories.summary: Ohio State's wide receiver corps is dealing with injuries, including to Devin McCuin and Brandon Inniss, as the Buckeyes prepare for Maryland. Receiver depth is a question mark for Saturday.

stories.title: Ohio State homecoming history ahead of Maryland game
stories.summary: Ohio State has faced Maryland on homecoming four times since 2000, winning each meeting by multiple touchdowns. This year's game against the Terrapins continues that homecoming pattern.

stories.title: McLaren targets Norris fuel-system issue with Singapore power-unit fixes
stories.summary: McLaren made peripheral changes to Lando Norris's Mercedes power unit to fix a persistent fuel-system problem that slowed him on Baku's straights. The team hopes it restores pace for the Singapore Grand Prix sprint weekend.

stories.title: Mercedes splits car specifications for Singapore, Russell runs older spec
stories.summary: Mercedes will run its W17 in split specifications at Singapore, with Kimi Antonelli keeping Sepang updates while George Russell reverts to his Baku car after the team's troubled aero upgrade. Russell called it a no-brainer comparison test.

stories.title: Christian Horner nine-figure Red Bull exit payout revealed
stories.summary: New UK Companies House filings show former Red Bull team principal Christian Horner received about 100.5 million pounds in compensation for loss of office after his July 2025 departure. The figure ranks among the largest in F1 history.

stories.title: FIA finishes investigation into Malaysia safety-car chaos
stories.summary: Ahead of the Singapore Grand Prix, the FIA published conclusions from its investigation into the chaotic start at Sepang, where half the field stopped behind the safety car. The governing body outlined measures to prevent a repeat.

stories.title: Players report scav raids failing to load across many servers
stories.summary: Multiple r/EscapeFromTarkov threads describe scav raids stalling at 'awaiting session start' or getting kicked to the menu, while PMC raids run fine. The issue appears widespread across central and EU servers.

stories.title: Players debate changed PMC AI behavior after 1.2.0.0
stories.summary: After the 1.2.0.0 patch reworked PMC bot behavior and faction relations, players are reporting tougher, more aggressive bot encounters. The discussion reflects ongoing tuning of Tarkov's revamped AI.

stories.title: Battlestate reveals Tarkov Arena Q4 2026 roadmap
stories.summary: Battlestate Games published its preliminary Q4 2026 roadmap for Escape from Tarkov: Arena, promising new content and features plus continued technical work. The studio cautioned that the plans may change before release.

stories.title: Scam targets Hilliard residents who applied for variances
stories.summary: The city of Hilliard warned that scammers may be using public hearing and case information to contact variance applicants with fake invoices. Residents are urged to verify any payment requests before paying.

stories.title: Def Leppard and Goo Goo Dolls announce Columbus tour stop
stories.summary: Def Leppard and the Goo Goo Dolls announced a co-headlining tour that includes a Columbus date, with one dollar per ticket going to the City of Hope cancer research center.

stories.title: Historic downtown Columbus Mercantile building sells for $8.9M
stories.summary: A Washington, D.C.-based investment firm bought the historic Mercantile building in downtown Columbus for $8.9 million, its first central Ohio acquisition. The deal adds to ongoing downtown redevelopment.

stories.title: Bayer to build $2.2B pharmaceutical plant in New Albany
stories.summary: Bayer announced a $2.2 billion pharmaceutical manufacturing plant in New Albany, Ohio, expected to create 1,500 construction jobs and 600 permanent roles. Gov. Mike DeWine called it Ohio's largest international healthcare project and the largest German direct investment in state history.
